channel.title: The Minnesota Star Tribune - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Minnesota Star Tribune (startribune.com)

item.title: Five extra points: Coaching tree for Mike Zimmer, MVP for RB, QB parting shots from Super Bowl LX
item.description: Seahawks QB Sam Darnold played third fiddle to a great defense and outstanding running back Kenneth Walker III in Seattle’s win over New England.

item.title: Twin Cities immigration crackdown delays home construction, slows real estate market
item.description: As immigrant workers move or stay home, a shortage of workers in the trades also is affecting the existing home market and rental owners.

item.title: The muse for a classic Replacements song has died
item.description: Lynn Blakey inspired one of the Minneapolis band’s most revered rock anthems, “Left of the Dial.”

item.title: The latest: Duluth curlers go for the gold medal Tuesday at the Winter Olympics
item.description: Korey Dropkin and Cory Thiesse have secured Team USA’s first medal in mixed doubles curling while Jessie Diggins and Paula Moltzan are also in the hunt for hardware at the Milan Cortina Games.

item.title: Daughter of governor candidate fatally stabbed in St. Cloud
item.description: The state Republican Party says Jeff Johnson is suspending his campaign.

item.title: Medtronic owes $382M after jury finds it violated monopoly laws
item.description: The Minnesota medtech giant plans to appeal the verdict. A California jury ruled that Medtronic’s bundling practices created unfair competition.

item.title: Takeaways: Timberwolves rumble past Atlanta 138-116 as Julius Randle has triple-double
item.description: Naz Reid was ejected after a second-half dustup with Mouhamed Gueye as the Wolves showed fight in ending a two-game losing streak.

item.title: The latest: Judge grants attorneys access inside Whipple building
item.description: DHS pushed back on Rep. Kelly Morrison’s characterization of poor conditions for detainees at the Fort Snelling federal building.

item.title: Trump administration to cut $600 million in health funding from Minnesota, 3 more states
item.description: The states, all led by Democrats, used the grants to support a wide variety of functions, including H.I.V. prevention and surveillance.

item.title: Minnesota flag sales soar during ICE surge
item.description: Some Twin Cities stores have sold out of Minnesota state flags in recent weeks.
